meta.name: apple-design
meta.description: Apple's approach to interface design and fluid, physical motion, translated for the web. Use when building or reviewing gesture-driven UI, spring animations, drag/swipe/sheet interactions, momentum and interruptible transitions, translucent materials and depth, typography (optical sizing, tracking, leading), reduced-motion, or the design foundations (feedback, spatial consistency, restraint) behind Apple-style interfaces.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把网页界面的手势、动效与排版打磨得自然顺滑
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在做手势或弹簧动画界面,想让交互更顺滑自然。
copy.tagline_en: Make web gestures, motion, and typography feel natural and fluid
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build gesture-driven or spring-animated interfaces and want them to feel natural.

howto.what: 让 Claude 按 Apple 的交互设计思路帮你写和审网页界面:手势驱动 UI、弹簧动画、可打断的拖拽/滑动/面板转场、半透明材质与层次、排版、减弱动效,并给出 CSS/JS 示例和阻尼比、response 等参数。
howto.when: 当你开发或审查手势驱动的界面、弹簧动画、可打断转场等场景,或询问 Apple 风格界面背后的设计基础时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一个可拖拽的底部面板,松手后按速度惯性吸附
say.note: 它会用动量投影选最近吸附点并交接速度

say.text: 给这个抽屉加弹簧动画,阻尼 1.0、response 0.4
say.note: 按 Apple 参数给 Motion 写法

say.text: 审查这个半透明工具栏,给出 backdrop-filter 的写法
say.note: 含材质层次与滚动边缘处理建议

howto.what_en: Claude then builds and reviews web interfaces the Apple way: gesture-driven UI, spring animations, interruptible transitions, translucency and depth, typography, reduced-motion — with concrete CSS/JS and damping/response values.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you build or review gesture-driven UI, spring animations, or interruptible transitions, or ask about the design foundations behind Apple-style interfaces.

say_en.text: Build me a draggable bottom sheet that snaps with momentum on release
say_en.note: It projects momentum and picks the snap target

say_en.text: Add a spring to this drawer with damping 1.0 and response 0.4
Review this translucent toolbar and give me the backdrop-filter CSS
say_en.note: Covers material weight and scroll edge effects
